generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All other terms and conditions are as per tender documents

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed, at least one similar work such as Annual Maintenance of lift or Supply, erection and commissioning of lift in any Power Generating station or any other utility in India as a prime contractor, of value not less than Rs. 5.50 Lakh in the preceding five years. (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit copy of single work order and corresponding satisfactory performance / work done certificate issued by competent authority (in case of state / central government / government undertaking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished. A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work / purchase orders to bring to the price level of current financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Single work order and corresponding satisfactory performance / work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have achieved a minimum financial turnover or an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 11 Lakh in any two financial years during the past Five Financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof, Turnover Certificate shall be furnished duly certified by Chartered Accountant. A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring to the price level of current financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective bidder should have a valid license / registration of the contract for the works and services of lifts and elevators issued by the Chief Electrical for lifts and Elevators of Government of Karnataka. As a proof, the bidder shall submit the License / registration certificate issued by competent authority

Those bidders whose contracts have been terminated / fore-closed by KPCL or whose performance has not been satisfactory while executing the contract within last three years are not eligible to participate in the bid. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking in this regard as per annexure-A of this tender.
A certificate for having read the clause of restrictions on public procurement from bidders of certain countries to be submitted / uploaded by the tenderer as per annexure-D of this tender.
